results.summary: The code was modified from using safe parameterized queries to vulnerable f-string interpolation, introducing a critical SQL injection vulnerability.
results.remediation_hint: Revert the change to use parameterized queries with placeholders (?) instead of string formatting.

results.summary: Hardcoded AWS credentials were added to the configuration file.
results.remediation_hint: Remove hardcoded credentials and load them from environment variables or a secure secret manager.

results.summary: An administrative endpoint exposing user data has been added without any authentication or authorization checks.
results.remediation_hint: Add proper authentication and authorization dependencies to ensure only admin users can access this endpoint.

results.summary: Introduction of Python eval() function on user-supplied template strings poses a severe remote code execution vulnerability.
results.remediation_hint: Remove eval() entirely and use a safe templating engine like string.Template or Jinja2 with autoescaping.

results.summary: Migration removes the NOT NULL constraint and unique index from the users.email column, breaking application contracts relying on unique non-null emails.
results.remediation_hint: Ensure application logic and authentication flows handle nullable, non-unique email addresses safely.

results.summary: Introduction of a critical command injection vulnerability via shell=True with unvalidated directory input.
results.remediation_hint: Avoid using shell=True and string formatting for system commands; use Path.glob and unlink as before or pass arguments as a list.

results.summary: Authentication verification has been completely disabled in the API handler, exposing endpoints to unauthorized access.
results.remediation_hint: Restore the JWT verification logic and do not deploy test-only bypasses to production.

results.summary: Introduction of arbitrary code execution vulnerability via unsafe pickle deserialization.
results.remediation_hint: Avoid using pickle.loads on untrusted data; use a safe serialization format like JSON.

results.summary: Stripe secret API key is being assigned from an instance attribute which may expose sensitive credentials if logged or improperly managed.
results.remediation_hint: Ensure STRIPE_SECRET is loaded securely from environment variables and never logged or exposed in client-facing code.

results.summary: The Terraform configuration explicitly disables all S3 public access blocks, potentially exposing sensitive data to the public internet.
results.remediation_hint: Set block_public_acls, block_public_policy, ignore_public_acls, and restrict_public_buckets to true unless public access is explicitly required and secured.
